name: Trim Stain Prep — Template (LF)
intent: Initial bare-wood stain prep for LF trim substrates — sand bare wood, fill small holes (nail / fastener marks), dust wipe, conditioner on softwood. Wood putty *defects* (larger fixes) moved to MOD_INTERSTAGE_TRIM_STAIN_LF per user direction 2026-05-12 — defects are revealed after the first coat dries, not before, so they belong in interstage.
doctrine: Stain prep template — bare wood initial sequence. WOOD_PUTTY_FILL (small nail/fastener-hole fills) only; defect patching moved to interstage. Conditioner is apply+wipe combined via TSK_CONDITIONER_LF (one task, softwood-gated).
